offerings.name: token_report
offerings.description: A one-page research note on any token: price, on-chain metrics, catalysts, risks and sources. Delivered as Markdown within the hour.

asset_symbol.description: Alias of token — either is accepted

offerings.deliverable: Markdown report (≤ 6 000 chars): summary · price and 24h change · key on-chain metrics · catalysts · risks · sources with URLs

offerings.name: code_review
offerings.description: Senior code review of a public repository or a pasted diff: correctness, security, performance, structure — with concrete fixes.

source.description: Public git URL, or the diff/code itself (≤ 20 000 chars)

focus.description: Optional: what to look at first (security, perf, tests…)

language.description: Optional: main language, if not obvious
